packet.explanation: Reading and tracing code means going through a program line by line, like a detective, to see exactly how each part works and how the values of variables change step by step. It helps you understand what the code is doing without running it on a computer.
packet.strategy: Read each line of code in order. Before each line, note the current value of every variable. After each line, update the variables based on the operation. Keep a running list of changes to track how values evolve step by step.
